target.title: fix(browser): guard readFields JSON.parse against malformed CLI input
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`extensions/browser/src/cli/browser-cli-actions-input/shared.ts:97` calls bare `JSON.parse(payload)` in `readFields()` when parsing `--fields` or `--fields-file` CLI input. Malformed user input → raw `SyntaxError` instead of descriptive validation error.

## Changes

- `shared.ts`: wrap `JSON.parse(payload)` in try/catch, throw `Error("fields must be valid JSON.")` instead of raw SyntaxError
- `test/_proof_browser_cli_shared_json_guard.mts`: standalone proof script (8/8 PASS)

Label: bugfix | merge-risk: 🟢 minimal | AI-assisted

## Evidence

```
$ node --import tsx test/_proof_browser_cli_shared_json_guard.mts

[1] malformed JSON fields → descriptive Error
  PASS  throws Error (not SyntaxError)
  PASS  message includes "must be valid JSON"

[2] valid JSON fields array → returns correctly
  PASS  no error thrown
  PASS  returns array
  PASS  returns 1 field

[3] empty fields string → throws validation Error
  PASS  throws Error for empty fields

[4] valid JSON non-array → throws validation Error
  PASS  throws Error for non-array
  PASS  message is schema error (not JSON parse error)

==================================================
  Passed: 8  Failed: 0  Total: 8
==================================================
```

Before: `readFields({ fields: "NOT JSON" })` → raw SyntaxError
After: `readFields({ fields: "NOT JSON" })` → `Error: fields must be valid JSON.`
